classification: Assignment and Transfer of Policy Administration
clause_text: This form is part of the policy and must be read with the declarations and endorsements. Rights and duties established under this commercial general liability contract cannot be transferred to another party without our written consent. Any attempted assignment or transfer of policy benefits lacking our express written authorization shall be considered void and legally unenforceable. The named insured cannot sell, assign, or otherwise transfer their interest in this insurance policy as part of a corporate transaction. In the event of a merger or acquisition, the surviving entity does not automatically inherit the protections of this specific policy. A formal request for transfer must be submitted to our underwriting department along with complete details of the proposed ownership change. We reserve the absolute right to approve or deny any transfer request based on our evaluation of the new risk profile. An exception to this strict prohibition exists in the event of the death of an individual designated as the first named insured. If an individual named insured dies, their rights and duties are temporarily transferred to their legal representative or estate executor. This temporary transfer of rights applies only while the legal representative is acting within the scope of their official duties. Until a legal representative is formally appointed, anyone having proper temporary custody of the deceased insured’s property assumes the policy duties. The temporary custodian is bound by all policy conditions, including the obligation to report incidents and cooperate with our investigations. Coverage for the legal representative or temporary custodian extends only to operations previously conducted by the deceased individual named insured. No new business ventures or expanded operations initiated by the estate will be protected under the existing commercial liability framework. Bankruptcy or insolvency of the insured does not relieve us of our obligations under this commercial general liability contract. However, a bankruptcy trustee does not gain the authority to expand the scope of operations beyond those scheduled in the declarations.

E. A separate electronic notification will be dispatched prior to drafting any amount that deviates from the standard installment schedule

You have the right to dispute any supplementary draft amount by contacting our billing department within three days of receiving the notification

Initiating a chargeback through your financial institution without first attempting to resolve the dispute with us constitutes a material breach of contract.

Unauthorized chargebacks will result in immediate policy cancellation and the rapid referral of the account balance to a commercial collections agency.

A. This form establishes the mandatory electronic funds transfer protocols for all premium transactions associated with this commercial general liability contract.

By accepting this policy, the first named insured agrees to enroll in our automated clearing house withdrawal program for all scheduled payments.

You must provide valid routing and account numbers for a commercial banking account drawn on a recognized financial institution within the United States.

The designated account must maintain sufficient available funds to cover all scheduled premium drafts on their respective processing dates without fail.

We will initiate the electronic draft exactly on the due date specified in the initial billing schedule provided at policy inception.

B. If the scheduled draft date falls on a weekend or federal banking holiday, the transaction will be processed on the next available business day.

An electronic statement will be generated and delivered to the registered email address exactly ten days prior to any scheduled withdrawal.

This electronic statement serves as the official invoice and fulfills our statutory obligation to provide advance notice of impending premium charges.

You are strictly responsible for ensuring that the email address on file is accurate and capable of receiving automated messages from our domain.

Failure to receive the electronic statement due to spam filters or inactive inboxes does not invalidate the scheduled electronic withdrawal.
